test_title: PYST 76: SSC GD Constable 2022 - English (Held On : 13 Feb 2023 Shift 4)
subject: english
question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution: The correct answer is: **Dalmation** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The spelling "**Dalmation**" is incorrect. The error lies in the missing letter '**i**' after '**m**.' • The correct spelling is "**Dalmatian**." • The correct name for the breed of dog with a distinctive black or liver-spotted coat is "**Dalmatian**." (विशिष्ट काले या जिगर-धब्बेदार कोट वाले कुत्ते की नस्ल) • **Example**: *The Dalmatian puppy's black spots stood out against its white coat, creating a distinctive and charming appearance.* Thus, **option 4** is the correct answer. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Venerate: **To regard with deep respect or reverence; to honour or worship. (गहरे आदर या श्रद्धा से देखना; सम्मान या पूजा करना) • **Viceregal: **Relating to or characteristic of a viceroy or the government of a viceroy. (किसी वायसराय या वायसराय की सरकार से संबंधित या उसकी विशेषता) • **Retinal: **Pertaining to the retina, the light-sensitive layer at the back of the eye. (रेटिना से संबंधित, आंख के पीछे प्रकाश-संवेदनशील परत) 31:Tb0e, The correct answer is** 'Destroy'.**
